edgeCases: All-whitespace search (e.g. '   '): trim() reduces to '' which is falsy; filter branch skips and all products pass — correct behavior once trim fix is applied

tasks.requirement: 1. filterProducts applies sorting after all filters, not before.
tasks.description: Move the sort block (currently at the top of filterProducts, before any filter steps) to after all three filter steps (search, category, inStockOnly). The sort must operate on the already-filtered result array, not the full unfiltered copy.

tasks.requirement: 2 & 3. Search matching is case-insensitive and trims leading/trailing whitespace from the input value before comparing.
tasks.description: In filterProducts(), replace product.name.includes(filters.search) with product.name.toLowerCase().includes(filters.search.trim().toLowerCase()). This satisfies both the case-insensitive requirement (req 2) and the trim requirement (req 3) while continuing to match only against product.name (req 4).

tasks.requirement: 9. The 'Clear filters' button resets all four FilterState fields: search to '', category to 'All', inStockOnly to false, and sortBy to 'default'.
tasks.description: In FilterPanel.tsx, add sortBy: 'default' to the object literal passed to onChange in the 'Clear filters' button onClick handler. The current spread ({ ...filters, search: '', category: 'All', inStockOnly: false }) leaves sortBy at whatever its current value is; adding sortBy: 'default' completes the full reset.
